speaking.title: Mexanik tarzda emas, tabiiy ravishda gapiring
speaking.description: 120 ta umumiy mavzular, 8–9-bandli javob modellari, mahalliy tilga o'xshash iboralar va AI ballsiz imtihonchi ko'rsatmalari.

sections.title: Sizni ilhomlantiradigan odamni tasvirlab bering
sections.description: Tabiiy javob oddiy yoy bo'ylab keladi: odamni aniqlang, aloqani tushuntiring, bitta aniq voqeani ayting, so'ngra ta'sir haqida o'ylang.
steps: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri oching: "Menga eng katta ta'sir ko'rsatgan odam ..."
Javobni sifatlarni ro'yxatga olish o'rniga ma'lum bir xotirada saqlang.
Hikoya uchun o'tgan zamondan foydalaning va davom etayotgan ta'sir uchun hozirgi zamondan foydalaning.
Mulohaza bilan yakunlang: "Meni eng hayratga soladigan narsa bu ..."
sections.example: The person who has had the greatest influence on me is my secondary-school English teacher. What set her apart was her ability to make every student feel capable. I vividly remember struggling with my first presentation; rather than correcting every mistake, she helped me organise my ideas and speak with confidence. That experience completely changed the way I approach difficult tasks. What I admire most is that she was demanding without ever being discouraging, and I still draw on her advice whenever I have to speak in public.

sections.title: Tekshiruvchining sevimli iboralari
sections.description: Ushbu iboralar g'oyalarni tartibga soladi va ular haqiqiy tarkibni kiritganda tabiiy bo'ladi. Har bir javobda hammasi emas, bitta yoki ikkitadan foydalaning.
vocabulary: What immediately comes to mind is...
The main reason I say that is...
I wouldn't go so far as to say..., but...
It had a lasting impact on me.
There is a lot to be said for...
It is something I have grown to appreciate.

sections.title: Aytishni to'xtating... Buning o'rniga buni ayting
sections.description: Noaniq so'zlarni faqat kuchliroq ibora sizning ma'nongizga mos kelganda yangilang.
vocabulary: very good → genuinely impressive / highly effective
very bad → deeply frustrating / seriously harmful
I like it → I am particularly fond of it
it is important → it plays a crucial role
a lot of people → a broad cross-section of people
I think → from my perspective / I would argue that
it changed me → it reshaped the way I see...
I was happy → I was genuinely delighted

sections.title: Foydali keyingi savollar namunalari
sections.description: 3-qism mukofotlar fikrlashni rivojlantirdi. Javob bering, sababini tushuntiring, misol keltiring, keyin fikringizni tasdiqlang.
steps: Nima uchun bu vaqt o'tishi bilan o'zgargan deb o'ylaysiz?
Bu masala uchun asosan kim javobgar bo'lishi kerak?
Bu tendentsiya barcha yosh guruhlarida bir xil darajada keng tarqalganmi?
Hech narsa qilinmasa nima bo'lishi mumkin?
Shaharlar va qishloqlar o'rtasidagi vaziyat qanday farq qiladi?
sections.example: I would say local authorities bear most of the responsibility because they control planning and public services. That said, individuals still have a role to play, particularly through their daily choices.

sections.title: Ravonlik, grammatika va talaffuz
sections.description: Ravonlik - bu imkon qadar tez gapirmaslik, boshqariladigan davomiylik. O'zingizga kichik rejalashtirish pauzalarini bering va mazmundagi so'zlarni ta'kidlang.
steps: 5–9 soʻzdan iborat fikr guruhlarini ishlating va iboralar ichida emas, fikrlar orasida pauza qiling.
Sodda gaplarni nisbiy ergash gaplar, shart ergash gaplar va ergash gaplar bilan aralashtiring.
Kontrastli stressni mashq qiling: "Men payshanba emas, seshanba kuni aytdim."
Har kuni bitta ikki daqiqalik javobni yozib oling va takroriy va tugallanmagan jumlalarni tinglang.
traps: Har bir kichik grammatik xatodan keyin qayta ishga tushirish

writing.title: Yuqori tarmoqli yozuv nima qilishini o'rganing
writing.description: Har bir asosiy vazifa 1 va 2-topshiriq turlari uchun namuna tuzilmalari, lug'at, grammatika va ball tahlillari.

sections.title: 2-topshiriq: fikr insho
sections.description: Kuchli fikr inshosi kirish qismida aniq pozitsiyani beradi va tezisni takrorlashdan ko'ra ikkita aniq sababni ishlab chiqadi.
steps: Kirish: masalani izohlab bering va aniq pozitsiyani bildiring.
1-modda: da'vo → tushuntirish → aniq misol → savolga havola.
2-tana: boshqa sababni ishlab chiqing yoki eng kuchli qarama-qarshilikka murojaat qiling.
Xulosa: yangi g'oyani kiritmasdan pozitsiyani takrorlang.
sections.example: Although remote work can weaken informal collaboration, its broader advantages are more significant. In particular, flexible working arrangements allow firms to recruit beyond their immediate location and enable employees to organise demanding tasks around periods of peak concentration. Provided that teams maintain clear communication routines, productivity and job satisfaction are therefore likely to improve.

sections.title: Munozara + fikr
sections.description: O'z hukmingizni chiqarishdan oldin ikkala nuqtai nazarni adolatli taqdim eting. Muhokama bir-biriga bog'liq bo'lmagan ikkita fikr paragrafi emas.
steps: Nega aqlli odamlar A qarashini qo'llab-quvvatlashini tushuntiring.
Mantiq va ko'rish chegaralarini tushuntiring B.
Kirish qismida o'z pozitsiyangizni bildiring va uni xulosada mustahkamlang.
sections.example: Those who favour free university education argue that tuition fees prevent capable students from low-income families from studying. Others contend that universal subsidies are costly and may benefit wealthy households unnecessarily. In my view, targeted financial support offers a fairer and more sustainable compromise.

sections.title: Muammolar, echimlar va ikki tomonlama savollar
sections.description: Har bir yechimni siz allaqachon tushuntirgan sababga moslang. Umumiy tavsiyalar kamdan-kam hollarda yaxshi baholanadi.
steps: Muammoni aniq nomlang va kimga ta'sir qilganini ko'rsating.
Muammoni keltirib chiqaradigan mexanizmni tushuntiring.
Aktyorni, harakatni va kutilgan natijani taklif qiling.
Ikki tomonlama savollar uchun har bir savolga alohida asosiy paragraf bering.
sections.example: One practical response would be for city councils to introduce integrated ticketing across buses and trains. By making transfers cheaper and simpler, this measure would remove a major barrier to public-transport use.

sections.title: Diagrammalar, jadvallar va aralash ingl
sections.description: Umumiy ko'rinish eng katta ahamiyatga ega. Raqamlarni qo'shishdan oldin ustun naqsh va eng mazmunli kontrastni aniqlang.
steps: Kirish: vizual ko'rsatadigan narsalarni so'zlab bering.
Umumiy koʻrinish: 2–3 ta asosiy xususiyat haqida batafsil raqamlarsiz hisobot bering.
Tafsilotlar: o'xshash tendentsiyalarni guruhlash; hech qachon har bir raqamni tartibda tasvirlamang.
“Ammo”, “aksincha”, “taxminan ikki baravar yuqori” va “mos ravishda” bilan solishtiring.
sections.example: Overall, car ownership rose in all three countries, although the increase was considerably sharper in Country A. By 2020, its figure had reached 68%, compared with just over half in the other two nations.

sections.title: Jarayonlar va xaritalar
sections.description: Jarayon hisobotlari ketma-ketlik va passiv tuzilmalarni talab qiladi; xaritalar joylashuv tili va o'zgarishlarning aniq hisobiga muhtoj.
steps: Jarayon: bosqichlar sonini va ketma-ketlik qayerda boshlanadi va qayerda tugaydi.
Aktyor ahamiyatsiz bo'lganda passiv shakllardan foydalaning: "Material isitiladi ..."
Xarita: o'zgarishlarni zonalar bo'yicha guruhlang va qo'shimchalar, olib tashlashlar va o'zgartirishlarni ajrating.
"Shimolga", "qo'shni", "bilan almashtirildi" va "aylantirildi" dan foydalaning.
sections.example: Overall, the site was transformed from a largely industrial area into a mixed residential district. The warehouse in the north was demolished and replaced by apartment blocks, while the riverside was converted into public parkland.

sections.title: Tekshiruvchilar qanday mukofot berishadi
sections.description: Yuqori chiziqli yozuv ta'sirchan bo'lishidan oldin aniq. Lug'at va grammatika ma'noni bezatish emas, balki keskinlashtirishi kerak.
steps: Vazifaga javob: har bir xatboshida aniq javob beriladi.
Muvofiqlik: taraqqiyot mantiqiy va havolani kuzatish oson.
Leksik manba: aniq birikmalar, boshqariladigan parafraz va bir nechta imlo xatolari.
Grammatika: ko'pgina jumlalarda xatosiz moslashuvchan diapazon.

reading.title: So'zning orqasida ma'no toping
reading.description: Tuzoqlar, parafraz va yuqori chastotali sinonimlar atrofida tuzilgan har bir keng tarqalgan savol turi uchun bosqichma-bosqich qo'llanmalar.

sections.title: Mos keladigan sarlavhalar
sections.description: Bitta takrorlanuvchi kalit so'zni emas, balki paragrafning asosiy maqsadini moslang.
steps: Birinchi va oxirgi jumlani o'qing, so'ngra paragrafning asosiy harakatini aniqlang.
Har bir sarlavhani asosiy g'oyasiga qisqartiring.
Faqat tafsilotni tasvirlaydigan sarlavhalarni olib tashlang.
Butun paragrafni tekshirish orqali moslikni tasdiqlang.
traps: Ikki sarlavha lug'atga ega, ammo faqat bittasi maqsadga mos keladi
sections.example: Paragraph: several failed attempts followed by a successful trial. Best heading: “A breakthrough after early setbacks.”

sections.title: To'g'ri / noto'g'ri / berilmagan
sections.description: True matn bilan rozi; Yolg'on unga ziddir; Berilmaganni isbotlab yoki inkor etib bo'lmaydi.
steps: Da'vo predmeti, fe'l va chegaralovchi so'zlarning tagiga chizing.
Sinonimlar orqali tegishli gapni toping.
Ma'noni, ayniqsa miqdor va darajani solishtiring.
Matn bitta muhim qism to‘g‘risida jim bo‘lsa, Berilmagan ni tanlang.
traps: Bayonotni umumiy bilimdan to'g'ri deb taxmin qilish

sections.title: Ha / Yo'q / Berilmagan
sections.description: Bu versiyada faktik maʼlumotlardan koʻra yozuvchining qarashlari sinovdan oʻtkaziladi. Muallifning fikrini toping.
steps: Munozaralar, shubhalar, qo'llab-quvvatlashlar va ogohlantirishlar kabi fikr belgilarini aniqlang.
Yozuvchining nuqtai nazarini keltirilgan tadqiqotchi nuqtai nazaridan ajrating.
Fikrning kuchi mos kelishini tekshiring.

sections.title: Gap va xulosani yakunlash
sections.description: Grammatika etishmayotgan so'z turini bashorat qiladi; matn aniq javob beradi.
steps: O'qishdan oldin so'z chegarasini tekshiring.
Bo'shliqdan ot, fe'l, sifat yoki sonni taxmin qiling.
Bo'shliq atrofidagi so'zlarning parafrazlarini qidiring.
Javobni aniq nusxa ko'chiring va birlik/ko'plik kelishigini tekshiring.

sections.title: Ko'p tanlov
sections.description: Har bir variantni tekshirish uchun da'vo sifatida ko'ring. Chalg'ituvchilar ko'pincha qisman to'g'ri, ammo boshqa savolga javob berishadi.
steps: Variantlarsiz dastani o'qing va javob maydonini taxmin qiling.
Variantlarni solishtirishdan oldin dalillarni toping.
Noto'g'ri ko'lam, sabab yoki vaqt bilan javoblarni yo'q qiling.
Bitta mos so'z emas, balki butun jumla tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanadigan variantni tanlang.

sections.title: Mos keladigan paragraf ma'lumotlari
sections.description: Siz aniq tafsilot, misol, taqqoslash yoki tushuntirishni topyapsiz. Paragraflar bir necha marta ishlatilishi mumkin.
steps: O'ziga xos nomlar, sanalar va texnik iboralarni aylantiring.
Mavhum gaplarni sinonimlarga aylantiring.
Paragraf bo'yicha skanerlang va ishlatilgan harflarni diqqat bilan yozib oling.

sections.title: Qisqa javob savollari
sections.description: Parchadagi so'zlar bilan javob bering va so'z chegarasiga aniq rioya qiling.
steps: Savolni kalit so'z xaritasiga aylantiring.
Ismlar yoki iboralar yordamida javob maydonini toping.
Sizning iborangiz kim, nima, qaerda, qachon yoki nima uchun javob berishini tekshiring.

sections.title: Yuqori chastotali o'qish sinonimlari
sections.description: IELTS imtihonida savol matni kamdan-kam hollarda takrorlanadi. Alohida juftlarni emas, sinonimik oilalarni tuzing.

listening.title: Chalg'ituvchidan keyin javobni eshiting
listening.description: 1–4-bo'limlar, aksanlar, raqamlar, xaritalar va oldini olish mumkin bo'lgan xatolarga olib keladigan lug'at uchun amaliy qo'llanma.

sections.title: Umumiy chalg'ituvchilarni tan oling
sections.description: Ma'ruzachilar ko'pincha bitta javobni eslatib o'tadilar, o'zlarini tuzatadilar, so'ngra yakuniy javobni aytadilar.
steps: Tuzatish signallarini tinglang: aslida, aksincha, o'rniga, kechirasiz.
Birinchi mos keladigan so'zdan keyin tinglashni davom eting.
Faqat yakuniy tasdiqlangan ma'lumotlarni yozing.
sections.example: “The meeting is on Thursday — sorry, I mean Tuesday the thirteenth.” Answer: Tuesday 13th.

sections.title: Raqamlar, sanalar va manzillar
sections.description: To'liq testlardan oldin ovoz kontrastlari va formatlashni o'rgating.
traps: Faqat raqam kerak bo'lganda valyuta belgisini yozish

sections.title: Xaritalar va yo'nalishlar
sections.description: Ovoz boshlanishidan oldin o'zingizni yo'naltiring va belgilangan kirish joyidan harakatni kuzatib boring.
steps: Kompas, kirish va belgilangan joylarni belgilang.
Qarama-qarshi, orqada, eng oxirida va darhol chap tomonda kabi iboralarni kuzating.
Xotiraga tayanish o'rniga qalamni karnay bilan harakatlantiring.

sections.title: 1–4 bo'lim strategiyasi
sections.description: Qiyinchilik ko'tariladi, chunki kontekst, ma'ruzachilar soni va akademik zichlik o'zgaradi.
steps: 1-bo'lim: shakllar, nomlar, narxlar va kundalik tartib.
2-bo'lim: bitta ma'ruzachi, ommaviy axborot, xaritalar va jihozlar.
3-bo'lim: talabalar muhokamasi; Kim roziligini, shubhasini yoki pozitsiyasini o'zgartirayotganini kuzatib boring.
4-bo'lim: akademik ma'ruza; nota tuzilishini bashorat qiling va ko'rsatkichni tinglang.

sections.title: Britaniya, Amerika va Avstraliya o'zgarishi
sections.description: Har bir urg'uga taqlid qilishdan ko'ra, sog'lom oilalarni o'rganing.

sections.title: Tez-tez chalkashib ketadigan so'zlar
sections.description: Bo'shliqni to'ldirishda ma'no va imlo muhim ahamiyatga ega.

sections.title: Grammatika va mavzuni bashorat qiling
sections.description: Bo'shliq atrofidagi so'zlar qanday javob berish mumkinligini ochib beradi.
steps: Maqolada odatda birlik sanaladigan ot bashorat qilinadi.
Raqam birlikni, sanani, narxni yoki ko'plik otni taxmin qilishi mumkin.
Bo'shliqdan oldingi sifat otni taxmin qilishi mumkin.
Yozishni boshlashdan oldin mumkin bo'lgan lug'atni faollashtirish uchun sarlavhalarni o'qing.

sections.title: Kundalik tinglash muammosi
sections.description: Qisqa, yo'naltirilgan takrorlash ko'plab testlarni passiv bajarishdan ko'ra samaraliroqdir.
steps: Asosiy fikrni yozmasdan bir marta tinglang.
Qayta tinglang va 30-45 soniya davomida transkripsiya qiling.
Transkript bilan solishtiring va qisqartirish yoki bog'langan tovushlarni belgilang.
Xuddi shu ekstraktni ikki marta soya qiling, stressni va pauzani nusxalash.

resources.title: Trend so'zlar
resources.description: Vaqt o'tishi bilan chiziq yoki ustun qanday harakatlanishini tasvirlaydigan fe'l va ravishlar — har qanday bar/line Task 1 javobining asosi.

groups.title: Ko'tarilish
groups.note: Fe'lni har xillashtiring, so'ng ravish yoki tezlik so'zi qo'shing — faqat 'increased'ni takrorlamang.

items.example: The number of users increased steadily between 2015 and 2020.
Sales soared after the product launch.
Prices edged up slightly over the decade.
Demand peaked at just over 80% in July.

groups.title: Pasayish
groups.note: Pasayish uchun ham xuddi shunday — faqat 'increase' so'zlari bilan yozilgan Task 1 javobi bir xilday ko'rinadi.

items.example: Unemployment declined throughout the period.
Exports plummeted during the crisis.
Inflation eased in the final quarter.

items.basic: went down to the lowest point
items.example: The market bottomed out in early 2009.

groups.title: Aniq yo'nalishsiz
groups.note: Haqiqiy ma'lumotlar kamdan-kam holda faqat bitta chiziq bo'ylab harakatlanadi — qolganini shular tasvirlaydi.

items.example: Rainfall fluctuated considerably from month to month.
Growth plateaued after 2018.

items.basic: stayed about the same, small changes
items.example: The rate remained broadly stable at around 5%.
China overtook the US in 2010.

groups.title: O'zgarish darajasini tasvirlash
groups.note: Faqat raqam kuchsiz — uni hajm so'zi bilan birga qo'llang.

items.example: There was a dramatic increase in car ownership.
A gradual rise was recorded in the same period.
The figure remained unchanged throughout.
The population doubled over thirty years.

resources.title: Process lug'ati
resources.description: Passive voice va ketma-ketlik so'zlari — process tavsifi ma'lumot tavsifidan nimasi bilan farq qiladi.

groups.title: Bosqichlarni ketma-ketlashtirish
groups.note: Har xillashtiring — har bir gapni 'keyin' bilan boshlagan process javobi ro'yxatga o'xshab qoladi, matnga emas.

items.example: Initially, the raw bamboo is harvested by hand.
Following this, the strips are crushed into a pulp.

items.advanced: once X has happened, Y is done
items.example: Once the fibres have been softened, they are spun into yarn.
Meanwhile, water is added to the mixture.
At the final stage, the fabric is cut and sewn into clothing.

groups.title: Passive voice (asosiy ko'nikma)
groups.note: Processda aniq ega yo'q — 'ishchilar uni maydalaydi' noto'g'ri; 'u maydalanadi' to'g'ri.

items.example: The bamboo stems are crushed to make a liquid pulp.
The liquid is filtered to separate the fibres.

items.advanced: it is left to dry / it is dried
items.example: The beans are left to dry in the sun for several days.

items.basic: after they do X, they do Y
items.advanced: after being X-ed, it is Y-ed
items.example: After being harvested, the cherries are depulped and fermented.

resources.title: Ulush lug'ati
resources.description: Butunning qismlarini tasvirlash uchun kasr va ulush so'zlari — bar/line javobida hech qachon kerak bo'lmaydigan lug'at.

groups.title: Ulush va foizlar
groups.note: Iborani haqiqiy songa mos tanlang — yarmidan kam narsa uchun 'ko'pchilik' deyish stil emas, faktik xato.

items.example: Exactly half of household spending went on housing.
Just under half of respondents chose this option.
The majority of the budget was allocated to education.

items.advanced: a quarter of · one in four
items.example: A quarter of the total came from renewable sources.

items.advanced: a negligible proportion · a tiny fraction
items.example: A negligible proportion of energy came from coal.

groups.title: Bo'laklarni solishtirish
groups.note: Pie-pair promptlari deyarli har doim ikkita chartni solishtirishni so'raydi — bu ballar aynan shu yerdan keladi.

items.advanced: the largest share · accounted for the largest proportion
items.example: Manufacturing accounted for the largest proportion of exports.

items.advanced: the smallest share · made up the least
items.example: Agriculture made up the least of the three sectors.

items.basic: it got bigger between the two charts
items.advanced: the share of X rose from ... to ...
items.example: The share of online sales rose from 12% to 34%.
Both sectors accounted for an almost identical proportion.

resources.title: Solishtirish lug'ati
resources.description: Jadvalda tasvirlanadigan vizual shakl yo'q — har bir gap qator yoki ustunlar orasidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri solishtiruv.

groups.title: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri solishtirish
groups.note: Jadval javobining asosiy tuzilishi: X, Y bilan solishtirganda.

items.example: Spending on health, compared with education, rose more slowly.
Tuition fees were higher than the national average.
The figure for rural areas was well below the urban rate.

items.advanced: on a par with · comparable to
items.example: Japan's figure was on a par with South Korea's.

groups.title: Superlativlar (eng yuqori / eng past)
groups.note: Har bir jadvalda eng yuqori va eng past bitta qator va ustun bor — ularni aniq nomlang.

items.advanced: the highest figure · the largest amount
items.example: Germany recorded the highest figure among the four countries.

items.advanced: the lowest figure · the smallest amount
items.example: The lowest figure was recorded in the final year.
Canada had the second-highest rate, just behind the US.

items.advanced: a marked disparity / a wide gap between
items.example: There was a wide gap between the highest and lowest figures.

resources.title: Line grafik ustaligi
resources.description: Kuchiga qarab tartiblangan trend fe'llari va ekzaminator birinchi tekshiradigan predloglar — line grafik javobiga kerak bo'ladigan chuqurroq lug'at.

groups.title: Oshish, kuchiga qarab
groups.note: Har doim 'increased'ni takrorlamang — o'zgarish kattalashgani sayin shu shkala bo'yicha yuqoriga o'ting.

items.example: The number of visitors rose steadily between 2010 and 2015.
Average prices climbed gradually over the decade.
Sales jumped in the month after the campaign launched.

items.basic: went up a huge amount, fast
items.example: Demand for the service skyrocketed after 2018.

groups.title: Pasayish, kuchiga qarab
groups.note: Xuddi shu shkala teskarisiga — fe'lni pasayish qanchalik keskin bo'lganiga moslang.

items.example: Unemployment fell throughout the period shown.
The birth rate declined gradually across the two decades.

items.basic: went down a huge amount, fast
items.example: Oil prices plummeted in the final quarter of 2015.

groups.title: Barqarorlik va tebranish
groups.note: Chiziq aniq ko'tarilmagan yoki tushmagan qismlari uchun.

items.example: Growth levelled off at around 40,000 units.

items.basic: went up and down a lot
items.example: Rainfall oscillated between 50mm and 90mm each month.

groups.title: Cho'qqi va eng past nuqta
groups.note: Har bir chiziqning eng yuqori va eng past qiymati bor — shaklini emas, aynan shu nuqtalarni nomlang.

items.advanced: reached a peak of · hit a record high
items.example: The figure reached a peak of 85% in 2019.

items.advanced: reached a low of · bottomed out at
items.example: The rate bottomed out at just 12% in 2012.

groups.title: Ikki chiziqni solishtirish
groups.note: Ko'pchilik line grafik topshiriqlarida ikki yoki undan ko'p qator chiziladi — bu ularning bir-biriga nisbatini tasvirlash uchun lug'at.

items.example: China overtook the US figure in 2010.
Coal consumption remained below gas throughout the period.
The gap between the two figures widened considerably after 2015.

groups.title: Raqamlar bilan predloglar
groups.note: Bu bo'limdagi eng ko'p uchraydigan grammatik xato — ekzaminatorlar buni birinchi tekshiradi.

items.example: The figure rose from 20% to 50% over the period.
The number increased by 30, from 20 to 50.
The figure stood at exactly 50% in 2010.
The temperature fluctuated between 20 and 50 degrees.

resources.title: Xarita lug'ati
resources.description: Joylashuvni bildiruvchi so'zlar va "oldin/keyin" xarita javobi tayanadigan majhul nisbat (passive voice) o'zgarish fe'llari.

groups.title: Joylashuv
groups.note: Nima o'zgarganini tasvirlashdan oldin narsalar qayerdaligini aniqlang.

items.advanced: is located in · is situated in
items.example: The new hospital is situated in the northern part of the town.
The car park is adjacent to the shopping centre.
The site was surrounded by open farmland in 2000.
A new housing estate was built on the outskirts of the town.

groups.title: O'zgarish — xaritaning asosiy grammatikasi
groups.note: Xaritada qurilishni bajaruvchi shaxs ko'rsatilmaydi, shuning uchun deyarli har doim majhul nisbat ishlatiladi: 'workers built it' xato, 'it was built' to'g'ri.

items.advanced: it was constructed / it was built
items.example: A new sports centre was constructed to the south of the river.

items.advanced: was converted into · was transformed into
items.example: The old warehouse was converted into a leisure centre.

items.basic: the old thing was removed for a new one
items.advanced: was replaced by · made way for
items.example: The old market was replaced by a supermarket.
The main road was widened to accommodate more traffic.

groups.title: Yo'llar va yo'l topish
groups.note: Transport o'zgarishlari deyarli har bir xarita topshirig'ida uchraydi.

items.example: The bus station was relocated closer to the town centre.

items.advanced: provided access to · was accessible via
items.example: A new footpath provided access to the riverside park.
A cycle path ran along the northern edge of the woodland.

groups.title: Yer resurslaridan foydalanish
groups.note: Yashil hudud yoki dala yo qolaveradi, yo qurilishga beriladi — ikkalasi uchun ham lug'at.

items.example: The area of woodland remained largely intact throughout the period.

items.advanced: was converted into green space · was landscaped
items.example: The disused railway line was converted into green space.

items.advanced: was cleared to make way for
items.example: Woodland was cleared to make way for new housing.

resources.title: Buning o'rniga foydalaning
resources.description: Noaniq lug'atni haqiqiy jumlaga mos keladigan aniq alternativalar bilan almashtiring.

groups.title: Baholash
groups.note: Ma'nosi bo'yicha tanlang; bu so'zlar har bir kontekstda bir-birini almashtirib bo'lmaydi.

items.example: Trust plays a pivotal role in effective leadership.
Flexible hours can be beneficial for working parents.
Air pollution has an adverse effect on public health.
The policy produced a substantial reduction in waste.
Numerous studies have examined this relationship.

groups.title: Akademik harakatlar
groups.note: Kuchli fe'llar sabab, dalil va o'zgarishlarni aniqroq qiladi.

items.example: Public libraries foster lifelong learning.
The figures indicate a gradual recovery.
Poor planning can lead to unnecessary delays.
Digital tools have transformed the workplace.
Residents were invited to comment on the proposal.

resources.title: Imtihon oluvchi bu so'zlarni yaxshi ko'radi
resources.description: Umumiy IELTS g'oyalarini aniqlik bilan ifodalovchi yuqori qiymatli so'zlar.

groups.title: Siyosat va jamiyat
groups.note: Ta'lim, sog'liqni saqlash, shaharlar va atrof-muhit uchun foydali.

items.example: An equitable system gives support according to need.
Cities need a sustainable approach to transport.
Resilient communities recover more quickly from disruption.
Public services should be accessible to rural residents.
Companies must be held accountable for pollution.

groups.title: O'zgarish va ta'sir
groups.note: O'lchov, sur'at va natijani tasvirlash uchun ulardan foydalaning.

items.example: Long commutes can exacerbate stress.
Trees help mitigate the urban heat-island effect.
High costs may hinder innovation.
Investment can stimulate local employment.
Technology now permeates almost every aspect of daily life.

resources.title: Aniq, boshqariladigan, tabiiy
resources.description: 9-band lug'ati noyob so'zlar emas, balki aniq birikma va moslashuvchan parafrazdir.

groups.title: Argument
groups.note: Tegishli ishonch darajasiga ega bo'lgan ramka da'volari.

items.example: There is compelling evidence that early intervention works.
Temporary restrictions may be justifiable during an emergency.
The long-term effect remains ambiguous.
It may seem paradoxical that greater choice can reduce satisfaction.
The issue requires a more nuanced response.

resources.title: Akademik birikmalar
resources.description: Tekshiruvchilar birgalikda ko'rishni kutgan birikmalardagi so'zlarni o'rganing.

groups.title: Dalil va tadqiqot
groups.note: To'liq so'z sherikliklari atrofida jumlalar tuzing.

items.example: Empirical evidence supports the proposed approach.
Further research should be conducted before implementation.
The trial yielded encouraging results.

items.advanced: a marked disparity · a marginal difference
items.example: A marked disparity remains between urban and rural access.
The reform may have far-reaching consequences.

groups.title: Trendlar va yechimlar
groups.note: 1-topshiriqni koʻrib chiqish va 2-topshiriq tavsiyalarida foydali.

items.example: Participation grew steadily throughout the period.

items.advanced: a pressing issue · pose a challenge
items.example: Housing affordability poses a serious challenge.

items.advanced: a viable solution · a targeted measure
items.example: Subsidised transport is a viable short-term solution.
Major polluters should bear the cost of restoration.

items.advanced: draw attention to · address a concern
items.example: The report draws attention to regional inequality.

resources.title: Universal IELTS iboralari
resources.description: Tahlil, misollar, kontrast va malaka uchun moslashuvchan jumlalar ramkalari.

groups.title: Argument ishlab chiqish
groups.note: Har bir ramkani ma'lum bir g'oya bilan to'ldiring.

items.advanced: One of the primary reasons is that...
items.example: One of the primary reasons is that public transport remains unreliable.

items.advanced: This, in turn, can lead to...
items.example: This, in turn, can lead to lower employee retention.

items.advanced: A clear illustration of this can be seen in...
items.example: A clear illustration of this can be seen in cities with integrated rail networks.

items.advanced: This is not to suggest that...
items.example: This is not to suggest that individual choices are irrelevant.

items.advanced: Provided that..., it is likely that...
items.example: Provided that funding is maintained, the scheme is likely to succeed.

speaking.title: Говорите естественно, а не механически
speaking.description: 120 общих тем, модели ответов для групп 8–9, фразы, подобные родным языкам, и рекомендации экзаменатора без оценки ИИ.

sections.title: Опишите человека, который вас вдохновляет
sections.description: Естественный ответ следует простой схеме: идентифицируйте человека, объясните связь, приведите одну конкретную историю, а затем подумайте о влиянии.
steps: Открыть прямо: «Человек, который оказал на меня наибольшее влияние, это…»
Закрепите ответ в одном конкретном воспоминании, а не перечисляйте качества.
Используйте прошедшее время для повествования и настоящее идеальное для продолжения влияния.
Закончите размышлением: «Больше всего я восхищаюсь…»
sections.example: The person who has had the greatest influence on me is my secondary-school English teacher. What set her apart was her ability to make every student feel capable. I vividly remember struggling with my first presentation; rather than correcting every mistake, she helped me organise my ideas and speak with confidence. That experience completely changed the way I approach difficult tasks. What I admire most is that she was demanding without ever being discouraging, and I still draw on her advice whenever I have to speak in public.

sections.title: Любимые выражения экзаменатора
sections.description: Эти фразы организуют идеи и звучат естественно, когда представляют реальное содержание. Используйте один или два, а не все из них в каждом ответе.
vocabulary: What immediately comes to mind is...
The main reason I say that is...
I wouldn't go so far as to say..., but...
It had a lasting impact on me.
There is a lot to be said for...
It is something I have grown to appreciate.

sections.title: Перестань говорить... Лучше скажи это
sections.description: Улучшайте расплывчатые слова только в том случае, если более сильная фраза соответствует вашему значению.
vocabulary: very good → genuinely impressive / highly effective
very bad → deeply frustrating / seriously harmful
I like it → I am particularly fond of it
it is important → it plays a crucial role
a lot of people → a broad cross-section of people
I think → from my perspective / I would argue that
it changed me → it reshaped the way I see...
I was happy → I was genuinely delighted

sections.title: Полезные шаблоны дополнительных вопросов
sections.description: Часть 3 поощряет развитие рассуждений. Ответьте, объясните почему, приведите пример, а затем обоснуйте свою точку зрения.
steps: Как вы думаете, почему со временем ситуация изменилась?
Кто должен нести основную ответственность за этот вопрос?
Является ли эта тенденция одинаково распространенной среди всех возрастных групп?
Что может случиться, если ничего не сделать?
Чем отличается ситуация в городах и сельской местности?
sections.example: I would say local authorities bear most of the responsibility because they control planning and public services. That said, individuals still have a role to play, particularly through their daily choices.

sections.title: Беглость, грамматика и произношение
sections.description: Беглость – это контролируемая непрерывность, не позволяющая говорить как можно быстрее. Делайте себе небольшие паузы в планировании и подчеркивайте содержание слов.
steps: Используйте группы мыслей из 5–9 слов и делайте паузы между идеями, а не внутри фраз.
Смешайте простые предложения с придаточными, условными и причастными предложениями.
Практикуйте контрастное ударение: «Я сказал вторник, а не четверг».
Ежедневно записывайте один двухминутный ответ и прислушивайтесь к повторениям и незаконченным предложениям.
traps: Заученные варианты, которые не отвечают на вопрос
Перезапуск после каждой небольшой грамматической ошибки

writing.title: Изучите, что дает письмо на высоких частотах
writing.description: Структуры моделей для каждого основного типа заданий 1 и 2 с анализом словарного запаса, грамматики и оценок.

sections.title: Задание 2: Эссе мнения
sections.description: В эссе с сильным мнением во введении четко излагается позиция и развиваются две отдельные причины, а не повторяется тезис.
steps: Введение: перефразируйте проблему и изложите четкую позицию.
Тело 1: претензия → объяснение → конкретный пример → ссылка на вопрос.
Тело 2: придумайте другую причину или рассмотрите самый сильный контраргумент.
Вывод: еще раз сформулируйте позицию, не внося новую идею.
sections.example: Although remote work can weaken informal collaboration, its broader advantages are more significant. In particular, flexible working arrangements allow firms to recruit beyond their immediate location and enable employees to organise demanding tasks around periods of peak concentration. Provided that teams maintain clear communication routines, productivity and job satisfaction are therefore likely to improve.

sections.title: Обсуждение + мнение
sections.description: Прежде чем выносить собственное суждение, честно изложите обе точки зрения. Дискуссия — это не два несвязанных между собой абзаца мнения.
steps: Объясните, почему разумные люди поддерживают точку зрения А.
Объясните логику и границы точки зрения Б.
Изложите свою позицию во введении и подкрепите ее в заключении.
sections.example: Those who favour free university education argue that tuition fees prevent capable students from low-income families from studying. Others contend that universal subsidies are costly and may benefit wealthy households unnecessarily. In my view, targeted financial support offers a fairer and more sustainable compromise.

sections.title: Проблемы, решения и двойные вопросы
sections.description: Сопоставьте каждое решение с причиной, которую вы уже объяснили. Общие рекомендации редко дают хорошие результаты.
steps: Точно назовите проблему и покажите, кого она касается.
Объясните механизм, создающий проблему.
Предложите актера, действие и ожидаемый результат.
Для двойных вопросов выделите каждый вопрос в отдельный абзац.
sections.example: One practical response would be for city councils to introduce integrated ticketing across buses and trains. By making transfers cheaper and simpler, this measure would remove a major barrier to public-transport use.

sections.title: Диаграммы, таблицы и смешанные визуальные эффекты
sections.description: Обзор имеет наибольшую ценность. Прежде чем добавлять числа, определите доминирующий образец и наиболее значимый контраст.
steps: Введение: перефразируйте то, что показывает визуальный элемент.
Обзор: сообщите о 2–3 основных функциях без подробных цифр.
Детали: сгруппируйте схожие тенденции; никогда не описывайте каждое число по порядку.
Сравните с «тогда как», «на контрасте», «примерно в два раза выше» и «соответственно».
sections.example: Overall, car ownership rose in all three countries, although the increase was considerably sharper in Country A. By 2020, its figure had reached 68%, compared with just over half in the other two nations.

sections.title: Процессы и карты
sections.description: Отчеты о процессах требуют последовательности и пассивных структур; картам нужен язык местоположения и четкое описание изменений.
steps: Процесс: укажите количество этапов, а также где начинается и заканчивается последовательность.
Используйте пассивные формы, когда действующее лицо не имеет значения: «Материал нагревается...»
Карта: группируйте изменения по зонам и различайте добавления, удаления и преобразования.
Используйте «к северу от», «рядом с», «был заменен» и «был преобразован в».
sections.example: Overall, the site was transformed from a largely industrial area into a mixed residential district. The warehouse in the north was demolished and replaced by apartment blocks, while the riverside was converted into public parkland.

sections.title: Что награждают экзаменаторы
sections.description: Написание высоких частот ясно, прежде чем оно впечатляет. Словарный запас и грамматика должны обострять смысл, а не украшать его.
steps: Ответ на задание: каждый абзац содержит четкий ответ.
Последовательность: прогресс логичен, ссылки легко отслеживать.
Лексический ресурс: точные словосочетания, контролируемый перефраз и небольшое количество орфографических ошибок.
Грамматика: гибкий диапазон, большинство предложений не содержат ошибок.

reading.title: Найдите смысл в формулировке
reading.description: Пошаговые руководства для каждого распространенного типа вопросов, построенные на ловушках, перефразировании и часто встречающихся синонимах.

sections.title: Соответствующие заголовки
sections.description: Соответствуйте основной цели абзаца, а не одному повторяющемуся ключевому слову.
steps: Прочитайте первое и последнее предложение, затем определите основной ход абзаца.
Сократите каждый заголовок до его основной идеи.
Удалите заголовки, описывающие только детали.
Подтвердите совпадение, проверив весь абзац.
traps: Заголовок повторяет одно существительное из абзаца.
Два заголовка имеют общий словарный запас, но только один соответствует цели
sections.example: Paragraph: several failed attempts followed by a successful trial. Best heading: “A breakthrough after early setbacks.”

sections.title: Верно/Неверно/Не указано
sections.description: Тру согласен с текстом; Ложь противоречит этому; Не данное не может быть ни доказано, ни опровергнуто.
steps: Подчеркните тему претензии, глагол и ограничивающие слова.
Найдите подходящее предложение через синонимы.
Сравните значения, особенно количества и степени.
Выберите «Не указано», если в тексте ничего не говорится об одной существенной части.
traps: Предполагая, что утверждение истинно на основе общих знаний

sections.title: Да / Нет / Не дано
sections.description: Эта версия проверяет взгляды автора, а не фактическую информацию. Найдите мнение автора.
steps: Определите маркеры мнений, такие как аргументы, сомнения, поддержка и предостережения.
Отделите точку зрения автора от точки зрения цитируемого исследователя.
Проверьте, совпадает ли сила мнения.

sections.title: Завершение предложения и резюме
sections.description: Грамматика предсказывает тип пропущенного слова; текст дает точный ответ.
steps: Перед чтением проверьте лимит слов.
Предскажите существительное, глагол, прилагательное или число по пробелу.
Найдите перефразирование слов вокруг пробела.
Точно скопируйте ответ и проверьте соответствие единственного/множественного числа.

sections.title: Множественный выбор
sections.description: Рассматривайте каждый вариант как утверждение, требующее проверки. Отвлекающие слова часто отчасти правдивы, но отвечают на другой вопрос.
steps: Прочитайте основу без вариантов и предскажите область ответа.
Прежде чем сравнивать варианты, найдите доказательства.
Исключите ответы с неправильным объемом, причиной или временем.
Выберите вариант, поддерживаемый всем предложением, а не одним совпадающим словом.

sections.title: Соответствующая информация о абзаце
sections.description: Вы находитесь на конкретной детали, примере, сравнении или объяснении. Абзацы можно использовать более одного раза.
steps: Обведите отличительные имена, даты и технические фразы.
Преобразуйте абстрактные утверждения в вероятные синонимы.
Просматривайте абзац за абзацем и внимательно записывайте использованные буквы.

sections.title: Короткие ответы на вопросы
sections.description: Отвечайте словами из отрывка и точно соблюдайте лимит слов.
steps: Превратите вопрос в карту ключевых слов.
Найдите область ответов, используя имена или парафразы.
Убедитесь, что ваша фраза отвечает на вопрос «кто, что, где, когда и почему».

sections.title: Синонимы к высокочастотному чтению
sections.description: IELTS редко повторяет формулировку вопроса в отрывке. Создавайте семейства синонимов, а не изолированные пары.

listening.title: Услышать ответ после отвлекающего
listening.description: Практическое руководство по разделам 1–4, акцентам, цифрам, картам и словарному запасу, вызывающему ошибки, которых можно избежать.

sections.title: Распознайте распространенные отвлекающие факторы
sections.description: Выступающие часто упоминают один ответ, поправляются, а затем дают окончательный ответ.
steps: Прислушивайтесь к сигналам коррекции: на самом деле, скорее, я имею в виду «извините», вместо этого.
Продолжайте слушать после первого совпадающего слова.
Пишите только окончательную подтвержденную информацию.
sections.example: “The meeting is on Thursday — sorry, I mean Tuesday the thirteenth.” Answer: Tuesday 13th.

sections.title: Числа, даты и адреса
sections.description: Потренируйте звуковые контрасты и форматирование перед полными тестами.
traps: Написание символа валюты, когда требуется только число
Отсутствуют -s во множественном числе в датах или единицах измерения.

sections.title: Карты и направления
sections.description: Сориентируйтесь до начала звука и следуйте за движением от указанного входа.
steps: Отметьте компасом, входом и фиксированными ориентирами.
Отслеживайте такие фразы, как напротив, за пределами, в дальнем конце и сразу слева от вас.
Перемещайте карандаш вместе с динамиком, а не полагайтесь на память.

sections.title: Стратегия раздела 1–4
sections.description: Сложность возрастает, поскольку меняются контекст, количество говорящих и академическая плотность.
steps: Раздел 1: формы, названия, цены и бытовые договоренности.
Секция 2: один докладчик, общественная информация, карты и удобства.
Секция 3: студенческая дискуссия; отслеживать, кто соглашается, сомневается или меняет позицию.
Раздел 4: академическая лекция; предсказывать структуру заметок и слушать указатели.

sections.title: Британский, американский и австралийский вариант
sections.description: Изучите здоровые семьи, а не пытайтесь имитировать каждый акцент.

sections.title: Слова, которые часто путают
sections.description: Значение и написание имеют значение в задачах по заполнению пробелов.

sections.title: Предсказать грамматику и тему
sections.description: Слова вокруг пробела показывают, какой ответ возможен.
steps: Артикль обычно предсказывает исчисляемое существительное в единственном числе.
Число может предсказывать единицу измерения, дату, цену или существительное во множественном числе.
Прилагательное перед пробелом может предсказать существительное.
Прочитайте заголовки, чтобы активировать вероятный словарный запас, прежде чем начнется запись.

sections.title: Ежедневное испытание на прослушивание
sections.description: Короткое целенаправленное повторение более эффективно, чем пассивное выполнение множества тестов.
steps: Прослушайте один раз основную мысль, не записывая ее.
Прослушайте еще раз и запишите 30–45 секунд.
Сравните с транскриптом и отметьте сокращения или связанные звуки.
Дважды затените один и тот же отрывок, копируя ударения и паузы.

resources.eyebrow: Master Writing · Бар и линейные графики
resources.title: Лексика трендов
resources.description: Глаголы и наречия, описывающие движение линии или столбца во времени — основа любого ответа Task 1 по bar/line.

groups.title: Рост
groups.note: Меняйте глагол, добавляйте наречие или слово скорости — не повторяйте только 'increased'.

items.example: The number of users increased steadily between 2015 and 2020.
Sales soared after the product launch.
Prices edged up slightly over the decade.
Demand peaked at just over 80% in July.

groups.title: Падение
groups.note: То же самое для падения — ответ Task 1 только со словами 'increase' звучит однообразно.

items.example: Unemployment declined throughout the period.
Exports plummeted during the crisis.
Inflation eased in the final quarter.

items.basic: went down to the lowest point
items.example: The market bottomed out in early 2009.

groups.title: Без чёткого направления
groups.note: Реальные данные редко движутся по прямой — это слова для всего остального.

items.example: Rainfall fluctuated considerably from month to month.
Growth plateaued after 2018.

items.basic: stayed about the same, small changes
items.example: The rate remained broadly stable at around 5%.
China overtook the US in 2010.

groups.title: Описание величины изменения
groups.note: Одно число слабо — добавляйте к нему слово величины.

items.example: There was a dramatic increase in car ownership.
A gradual rise was recorded in the same period.
The figure remained unchanged throughout.
The population doubled over thirty years.

resources.title: Лексика процессов
resources.description: Пассивный залог и слова последовательности — чем описание процесса отличается от описания данных.

groups.title: Последовательность этапов
groups.note: Меняйте их — ответ, где каждое предложение начинается с 'затем', читается как список, а не текст.

items.example: Initially, the raw bamboo is harvested by hand.
Following this, the strips are crushed into a pulp.

items.advanced: once X has happened, Y is done
items.example: Once the fibres have been softened, they are spun into yarn.
Meanwhile, water is added to the mixture.
At the final stage, the fabric is cut and sewn into clothing.

groups.title: Пассивный залог (ключевой навык)
groups.note: У процесса нет названного исполнителя — 'рабочие измельчают его' неверно; 'он измельчается' верно.

items.example: The bamboo stems are crushed to make a liquid pulp.
The liquid is filtered to separate the fibres.

items.advanced: it is left to dry / it is dried
items.example: The beans are left to dry in the sun for several days.

items.basic: after they do X, they do Y
items.advanced: after being X-ed, it is Y-ed
items.example: After being harvested, the cherries are depulped and fermented.

resources.title: Лексика долей
resources.description: Слова для описания частей целого — лексика, которая никогда не нужна в ответе по bar/line.

groups.title: Доли и проценты
groups.note: Подбирайте фразу под реальное число — 'большинство' для доли меньше половины — это фактическая ошибка.

items.example: Exactly half of household spending went on housing.
Just under half of respondents chose this option.
The majority of the budget was allocated to education.

items.advanced: a quarter of · one in four
items.example: A quarter of the total came from renewable sources.

items.advanced: a negligible proportion · a tiny fraction
items.example: A negligible proportion of energy came from coal.

groups.title: Сравнение долей
groups.note: Промпты pie-pair почти всегда просят сравнить два чарта — именно отсюда берутся эти баллы.

items.advanced: the largest share · accounted for the largest proportion
items.example: Manufacturing accounted for the largest proportion of exports.

items.advanced: the smallest share · made up the least
items.example: Agriculture made up the least of the three sectors.

items.basic: it got bigger between the two charts
items.advanced: the share of X rose from ... to ...
items.example: The share of online sales rose from 12% to 34%.
Both sectors accounted for an almost identical proportion.

resources.title: Лексика сравнения
resources.description: У таблицы нет визуальной формы для описания — каждое предложение это прямое сравнение строк или столбцов.

groups.title: Прямое сравнение
groups.note: Основная структура ответа по таблице: X по сравнению с Y.

items.example: Spending on health, compared with education, rose more slowly.
Tuition fees were higher than the national average.
The figure for rural areas was well below the urban rate.

items.advanced: on a par with · comparable to
items.example: Japan's figure was on a par with South Korea's.

groups.title: Превосходная степень (самый высокий / самый низкий)
groups.note: В каждой таблице есть одна строка и один столбец с крайними значениями — называйте их прямо.

items.advanced: the highest figure · the largest amount
items.example: Germany recorded the highest figure among the four countries.

items.advanced: the lowest figure · the smallest amount
items.example: The lowest figure was recorded in the final year.
Canada had the second-highest rate, just behind the US.

items.advanced: a marked disparity / a wide gap between
items.example: There was a wide gap between the highest and lowest figures.

resources.title: Мастерство линейного графика
resources.description: Глаголы тренда, ранжированные по силе изменения, и предлоги, которые экзаменатор проверяет в первую очередь — лексика глубже базовой.

groups.title: Рост, по силе
groups.note: Не повторяйте 'increased' — поднимайтесь по этой шкале по мере роста изменения.

items.example: The number of visitors rose steadily between 2010 and 2015.
Average prices climbed gradually over the decade.
Sales jumped in the month after the campaign launched.

items.basic: went up a huge amount, fast
items.example: Demand for the service skyrocketed after 2018.

groups.title: Падение, по силе
groups.note: Та же шкала в обратную сторону — подбирайте глагол по резкости падения.

items.example: Unemployment fell throughout the period shown.
The birth rate declined gradually across the two decades.

items.basic: went down a huge amount, fast
items.example: Oil prices plummeted in the final quarter of 2015.

groups.title: Стабильность и колебания
groups.note: Для тех участков линии, которые явно не растут и не падают.

items.example: Growth levelled off at around 40,000 units.

items.basic: went up and down a lot
items.example: Rainfall oscillated between 50mm and 90mm each month.

groups.title: Пик и самая низкая точка
groups.note: У каждой линии есть высшая и низшая точка — называйте их прямо, а не просто описывайте форму.

items.advanced: reached a peak of · hit a record high
items.example: The figure reached a peak of 85% in 2019.

items.advanced: reached a low of · bottomed out at
items.example: The rate bottomed out at just 12% in 2012.

groups.title: Сравнение двух линий
groups.note: Большинство заданий с линейным графиком показывают два и более ряда — вот лексика для описания их соотношения.

items.example: China overtook the US figure in 2010.
Coal consumption remained below gas throughout the period.
The gap between the two figures widened considerably after 2015.

groups.title: Предлоги с числами
groups.note: Самая частая грамматическая ошибка в этом разделе — экзаменаторы проверяют это в первую очередь.

items.example: The figure rose from 20% to 50% over the period.
The number increased by 30, from 20 to 50.
The figure stood at exactly 50% in 2010.
The temperature fluctuated between 20 and 50 degrees.

resources.title: Лексика карт
resources.description: Лексика местоположения и глаголы изменения в страдательном залоге, на которых строится ответ «до/после» по карте.

groups.title: Местоположение
groups.note: Сначала укажите, где что находится, прежде чем описывать изменения.

items.advanced: is located in · is situated in
items.example: The new hospital is situated in the northern part of the town.
The car park is adjacent to the shopping centre.
The site was surrounded by open farmland in 2000.
A new housing estate was built on the outskirts of the town.

groups.title: Изменение — основная грамматика карт
groups.note: На карте не указан исполнитель постройки, поэтому почти всегда используется страдательный залог: 'workers built it' — неверно, 'it was built' — верно.

items.advanced: it was constructed / it was built
items.example: A new sports centre was constructed to the south of the river.

items.advanced: was converted into · was transformed into
items.example: The old warehouse was converted into a leisure centre.

items.basic: the old thing was removed for a new one
items.advanced: was replaced by · made way for
items.example: The old market was replaced by a supermarket.
The main road was widened to accommodate more traffic.

groups.title: Дороги и доступ
groups.note: Изменения транспорта встречаются почти в каждом задании с картой.

items.example: The bus station was relocated closer to the town centre.

items.advanced: provided access to · was accessible via
items.example: A new footpath provided access to the riverside park.
A cycle path ran along the northern edge of the woodland.

groups.title: Землепользование
groups.note: Зелёная зона или ферма либо остаётся неизменной, либо застраивается — лексика для обоих случаев.

items.example: The area of woodland remained largely intact throughout the period.

items.advanced: was converted into green space · was landscaped
items.example: The disused railway line was converted into green space.

items.advanced: was cleared to make way for
items.example: Woodland was cleared to make way for new housing.

resources.title: Используйте это вместо этого
resources.description: Замените расплывчатую лексику точными альтернативами, которые соответствуют реальному предложению.

groups.title: Оценка
groups.note: Выбирайте по смыслу; эти слова не являются взаимозаменяемыми в каждом контексте.

items.example: Trust plays a pivotal role in effective leadership.
Flexible hours can be beneficial for working parents.
Air pollution has an adverse effect on public health.
The policy produced a substantial reduction in waste.
Numerous studies have examined this relationship.

groups.title: Академические действия
groups.note: Сильные глаголы поясняют причины, доказательства и изменения.

items.example: Public libraries foster lifelong learning.
The figures indicate a gradual recovery.
Poor planning can lead to unnecessary delays.
Digital tools have transformed the workplace.
Residents were invited to comment on the proposal.

resources.title: Экзаменатор любит эти слова
resources.description: Ценные слова, которые точно выражают общие идеи IELTS.

groups.title: Политика и общество
groups.note: Полезно в сфере образования, здравоохранения, городов и окружающей среды.

items.example: An equitable system gives support according to need.
Cities need a sustainable approach to transport.
Resilient communities recover more quickly from disruption.
Public services should be accessible to rural residents.
Companies must be held accountable for pollution.

groups.title: Изменения и влияние
groups.note: Используйте их для описания масштаба, темпа и последствий.

items.example: Long commutes can exacerbate stress.
Trees help mitigate the urban heat-island effect.
High costs may hinder innovation.
Investment can stimulate local employment.
Technology now permeates almost every aspect of daily life.

resources.title: Точный, контролируемый, естественный
resources.description: Словарный запас группы 9 — это точные словосочетания и гибкий перефраз, а не редкие слова.

groups.title: Аргумент
groups.note: Формулируйте претензии с соответствующей степенью уверенности.

items.example: There is compelling evidence that early intervention works.
Temporary restrictions may be justifiable during an emergency.
The long-term effect remains ambiguous.
It may seem paradoxical that greater choice can reduce satisfaction.
The issue requires a more nuanced response.

resources.title: Академические словосочетания
resources.description: Изучите слова в комбинациях, которые экзаменаторы ожидают увидеть вместе.

groups.title: Доказательства и исследования
groups.note: Постройте предложения из полных словосочетаний.

items.example: Empirical evidence supports the proposed approach.
Further research should be conducted before implementation.
The trial yielded encouraging results.

items.advanced: a marked disparity · a marginal difference
items.example: A marked disparity remains between urban and rural access.
The reform may have far-reaching consequences.

groups.title: Тенденции и решения
groups.note: Полезно в обзорах задачи 1 и рекомендациях задачи 2.

items.example: Participation grew steadily throughout the period.

items.advanced: a pressing issue · pose a challenge
items.example: Housing affordability poses a serious challenge.

items.advanced: a viable solution · a targeted measure
items.example: Subsidised transport is a viable short-term solution.
Major polluters should bear the cost of restoration.

items.advanced: draw attention to · address a concern
items.example: The report draws attention to regional inequality.

resources.title: Универсальные фразы IELTS
resources.description: Гибкие рамки предложений для анализа, примеров, контраста и квалификации.

groups.title: Развивайте аргумент
groups.note: Дополните каждый кадр определенной идеей.

items.advanced: One of the primary reasons is that...
items.example: One of the primary reasons is that public transport remains unreliable.

items.advanced: This, in turn, can lead to...
items.example: This, in turn, can lead to lower employee retention.

items.advanced: A clear illustration of this can be seen in...
items.example: A clear illustration of this can be seen in cities with integrated rail networks.

items.advanced: This is not to suggest that...
items.example: This is not to suggest that individual choices are irrelevant.

items.advanced: Provided that..., it is likely that...
items.example: Provided that funding is maintained, the scheme is likely to succeed.
